documented_probe: C-92072676 (connect to a postgres service using compose-provided credentials): covering task at the documented medium floor; the verifier fully exercises the capability (derive host/port/db/user/password from arbitrary compose files, connect over scram-authenticated TCP, fail safely on bad credentials).
notes: Single-stage: parse a compose-style stack file, derive all connection facts, connect over password-authenticated TCP, run a fixed aggregation, emit a strict report shape. Hidden cases generalize across credentials, database names, and a second cluster on a different published port; a wrong-password case enforces fail-safe behavior and proves the password is actually used. Small rubric nonzero for tool breadth (psql/compose parsing), reasoning depth (host-side port extraction, quoted scalars), debugging ambiguity (connection failure paths), adversarial inputs (badpass), hidden generalization, and quantitative correctness. No dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to medium.
